plan.thesis: A refinery is judged on its margin per barrel of crude: the screen prices that barrel before any capital is spent, the plan finds it with every barrel run through the crude unit, the schedule dates it, and the actuals are read against it line by line on what each gap did to margin.

tiers.beginner: THE MODULAR SCREEN: modularRefinery. Graded: two capital costs, the slate value, annual throughput, gross margin per barrel, first-year revenue.
tiers.intermediate: THE PLAN AND THE SCHEDULE: refineryPlanning planRefinery and cascadeToSchedule. Graded: crude run, crude unit utilisation, plan margin, gross margin per barrel, two stream values.
tiers.advanced: ACTUALS, VARIANCE AND THE INVESTMENT CASE: streamModel attributeVariance, reconcilePeriod, feasibilityEconomics. Graded: a price variance, a volume variance, the margin total, the cost total, the first tax and the lifetime tax. No NPV or IRR.

digest.note: No section is history. SECTION 24 states the owner decisions in force and the HELD items. materialBalance and dualLedgerTotals are left out (RECON 3b, 3c, STOPPED).

grading.grader: public.academy_submit_capstone reads expected, tol and the answer as numeric: abs(got - expected) <= tol, tol absolute in the field's units. No NPV, IRR or label is graded.
grading.tolerance: One derivation, CLASSES in refinery_fields_capstone.mjs: USD and bbl 0.5 (whole unit; the digest prints two decimals), $/bbl 0.005 (the cent; the digest prints four), percent 0.005 (the digest prints two), MM 0.00005 (the digest prints four). The stored value is the engine's rounded six places past the graded place.
grading.collisionRule: No graded value within its tolerance of the absolute value of any number token the digest prints, and no two graded values within the looser of their tolerances.
